references.text: Joseph was sold by his brothers to the Ishmaelites, who took him to Egypt.
The Midianites sold Joseph in Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh and captain of the guard.
The psalm reminds us that God sent Joseph ahead of them to Egypt, sold as a slave – a direct reference to this event.
Stephen's speech mentions that the patriarchs sold Joseph into Egypt out of jealousy, but God was with him.
Direct continuation showing the consequence of Potiphar's purchase and Joseph's immediate service.
